heading: Is Oat-flour gluten free?
intro: This public analysis report explains the biggest gluten risks in Oat-flour and how to order more safely.

verdict.summary: Oat flour can be contaminated with gluten due to cross-contact during processing or if it is not made from certified gluten-free oats. Individuals with coeliac disease should ensure they are using oats that are specifically labeled gluten-free.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.body: Oat-flour can vary by recipe, ingredients, and cross-contact controls in the kitchen.

sections.title: Common gluten risks
sections.body: Watch for hidden sources like soy sauce, malt flavoring, marinades, thickeners, and shared fryers.

faq.question: What should I ask a restaurant?
